df = merged[numerical_cols].dropna()

# Function for comprehensive pairwise analysis
def analyze_pair(col1, col2):
    results = {}
    
    # Pearson correlation
    pearson = stats.pearsonr(df[col1], df[col2])
    results['pearson'] = {
        'r': pearson[0],
        'p-value': pearson[1]
    }
    
    # Spearman correlation
    spearman = stats.spearmanr(df[col1], df[col2])
    results['spearman'] = {
        'rho': spearman[0],
        'p-value': spearman[1]
    }
    
    # Mutual information (discrete approximation)
    x_vals = df[col1].value_counts().sort_index()
    y_vals = df[col2].value_counts().sort_index()
    mi = stats.entropy(x_vals * y_vals, x_vals + y_vals) / len(x_vals)
    results['mutual_info'] = mi
    
    # Linear regression
    X = sm.add_constant(df[col1])
    model = sm.OLS(df[col2], X).fit()
    results['regression'] = {
        'r_squared': model.rsquared,
        'slope': model.params[1],
        'intercept': model.params[0],
        'residuals': model.resid
    }

        for metric, value in res.items():

plt.title('Numerical Features Correlation Matrix')
plt.savefig('correlation_heatmap.png')
plt.close()

# Close connection
conn.close()
